records.title: C295: Indian public buyer → Spanish prime → Tata consortium
records.summary: The 24 September 2021 MoD–Airbus contract covers 56 aircraft: 16 flyaway and 40 Indian-built by a TASL-led consortium also naming TCS. PIB later states INR 21,935 crore total project cost, without allocating Tata receipts. Airbus records 16 cumulative deliveries at 30 June 2026. The 2024 assembly-line inauguration is a production milestone, not delivery of all 40.
